summary: Building true prosperity requires adopting the **mental model and identity of the top 1%**, which means believing you are fully worthy of success rather than relying solely on endless tactics. Instead of **hoarding cash like a conservative collector**, individuals should actively deploy their money to buy back time and delegate low-value tasks using a strict hourly ROI formula. Furthermore, achieving massive financial goals depends on **expanding your time horizon** by mapping out a 25-year vision and taking immediate, decisive action on your most important next steps. Ultimately, the true purpose of accumulating wealth is to **die empty by generously giving your resources**, time, and energy to help others succeed while you are still alive.
